name: Gabriele Dell'Otto
description: Gabriele Dell'Otto is a renowned Italian illustrator and painter born in Rome in 1973. He is best known for his dynamic work in comic books, particularly with Marvel and DC Comics, where he has created iconic covers and interior art for titles like Secret War , X-Force: Sex and Violence , and Annihilation . Trained at the European Design Institute, Dell'Otto began his career in scientific illustration before transitioning to comics, video games, and editorial work. His style blends classical technique with dramatic realism, making him one of the most published cover artists in the industry.
